releases.name: Tender360 - V2.4.5
releases.notes:
Hi Team,

We are pleased to announce that the latest **Tender360** update has been successfully deployed and is now available for use.

The following functionalities, enhancements, fixes, and new portal integrations have been implemented.

---

### **Completed Features & Enhancements**

1. **Enhanced Tender Data Extraction**

   * Improved tender scraping to reliably extract important tender dates including Publication Date, Bid Start Date, Bid End Date, Opening Date, and other available dates.
   * Decoupled document and corrigendum extraction from date extraction to ensure tender documents, corrigendum details, and related metadata are captured independently.

2. **"In Monitoring" Status**

   * Added an **In Monitoring** status indicator for tenders already present in the Tender Watchlist.
   * Status updates immediately after adding a tender and remains consistent across sessions.

3. **EMD Threshold-Based Tender Discovery**

   * Introduced configurable EMD Threshold settings for discovering tenders without Tender Value.
   * Added a dedicated **EMD** tab to display tenders identified using EMD-based qualification.

4. **Category-wise EMD Threshold**

   * Added support for configuring different EMD threshold values for each tender category.
   * Scraping now evaluates category-specific EMD thresholds when Tender Value is unavailable.

5. **Multi-Keyword Search**

   * Enhanced Tender Discovery search to support multiple keywords in a single query.
   * Users can now search using combinations such as **SCADA + Water**, **Water + PLC**, and similar keyword combinations.

6. **ROI Dashboard**

   * Added a graphical ROI dashboard comparing:

     * Total Shared Tender Value
     * Total Won Tender Value
   * Dashboard updates dynamically based on tender data.

7. **User-wise Track Tender Reports**

   * Users can now generate reports containing only the tenders assigned to or managed by them.
   * Export respects all applied filters.

8. **Dynamic Category Tabs**

   * Tender Discovery now organizes tenders into dynamically generated category tabs based on System Settings.
   * Includes an **All** tab displaying all discovered tenders.

9. **Add to Monitor Improvements**

   * Resolved issues where certain eligible tenders could not be added to Tender Monitoring.
   * Improved validation and user feedback during monitoring operations.

10. **Archive Tender Monitoring Fix**

* Archive tenders can now be added to Tender Monitoring even when EMD information is unavailable.
* Removed unnecessary dependency on EMD values for eligible archive tenders.

11. **Minor Fixes & Performance Improvements**

* Various improvements have been implemented to enhance stability, usability, tender discovery, and monitoring workflows.

---

### **New Tender Portal Integrations**

The following tender portals have been integrated into Tender360 and are now included in the automated tender scraping process:

• Manipur State Portal

• Meghalaya State Portal

• Mizoram State Portal

• Asian Development Bank (ADB)

• Nagpur Municipal Corporation

• Thane Municipal Corporation

• Corporation of the City of Panaji

• Rourkela Municipal Corporation

• Greater Chennai Corporation

• Coimbatore City Municipal Corporation

• Thiruvananthapuram Municipal Corporation

• Kozhikode Municipal Corporation

• Puducherry Municipal Council

• Surat Municipal Corporation

---

### **Current Version**

**Version: 2.4.5**

---

### **QA Status**

• All functional, validation, tender discovery, reporting, and monitoring scenarios have been successfully validated.

• Newly integrated tender portals have undergone initial validation.

• No critical or blocking issues were identified during testing.

---

### **Notes**

• Tender scraping has been enhanced to ensure important dates, corrigendum details, tender documents, and related metadata are extracted independently.

• Tender Discovery now supports multi-keyword search and dynamic category-based organization.

• Users can easily identify monitored tenders using the new **In Monitoring** status.

• Category-wise EMD Threshold configuration provides greater flexibility in discovering tenders without Tender Value.

• ROI Dashboard and User-wise Track Tender Reports are now available for improved reporting and business analysis.

• Newly integrated tender portals will be monitored during scheduled scraping cycles to validate data consistency.

• Kindly review the newly implemented functionalities during your regular workflow.

• If you encounter any issues, unexpected behavior, or observe any functionality not working as per the discussed requirements, kindly let us know so that we can review and address them promptly.

---

The latest build is now ready for deployment and usage.

Please review the implemented changes and share your feedback.

Thanks & Regards,

**Dwip Pandya**

releases.name: Tender360 - V2.4.4
releases.notes:
Hi Team,

We are pleased to announce that the latest **Tender360** update has been successfully deployed and is now available for use.

The following functionalities, enhancements, and improvements have been implemented.

---

### **Completed Features & Enhancements**

1. **Enhanced Tender Monitoring Export**

   * Added additional outcome-related information in Tender Monitoring exports.
   * Export now includes Bidders, Winner Name, Awarded Vendor, and Rejection Reason (where available).

2. **Tender Watchlist Date Range Filter**

   * Added From Date and To Date filters in the Tender Watchlist.
   * Export functionality now respects all applied filters, including the selected date range.

3. **Keyword Category Rename**

   * Authorized users can now rename existing Keyword Categories.
   * Existing keyword mappings remain intact after renaming.

4. **Watchlist Added Date & Time**

   * Added Watchlist Added Date and Time columns to help users identify when tenders were added to the Watchlist.

5. **Automatic Monitoring for Archived Forwarded Tenders**

   * Archived tenders that are forwarded are now automatically added to the Watchlist.
   * Monitoring continues for corrigendum updates and other tender changes without manual intervention.

6. **AOC Monitoring Availability Notification**

   * Added an informational notification while forwarding tenders from portals where AOC monitoring is not yet supported.
   * The notification informs users that manual monitoring is required until AOC support becomes available.

7. **Support for Undefined Tender Values**

   * Updated tender discovery logic to include tenders with Tender Values of **0**, **N/A**, or **Blank**.
   * Eligible tenders are no longer skipped due to undefined values.

8. **Global Removal from Monitoring & Watchlist**

   * Added functionality to remove tenders from Tender Monitoring and Tender Watchlist.
   * Removed tenders are reflected globally for all users.

9. **Minor Fixes & Improvements**

   * Various UI, usability, performance, and stability improvements have been implemented across the application.

---

### **Released for Monitoring**

The following enhancements have been deployed to Production for monitoring purposes. Since these functionalities depend on live tender updates and production data, initial sanity validation has been completed by QA, and they will continue to be monitored in the production environment.

1. **Consolidated Corrigendum Email Notifications**

   * Multiple corrigendum updates are consolidated into a single email.
   * Improved email readability and reduced notification volume.
   * Users can directly navigate to the respective Tender Details page from the email.

2. **Tender Acceptance Hierarchy Notifications**

   * Implemented hierarchical email notifications for tenders in the **Accepted for Bidding** stage.
   * A single notification email is sent to all users involved in the approval hierarchy whenever tender updates occur.
   * Includes direct navigation to the corresponding Tender Details page.
   * Komal Ma'am is included in CC for all such notifications.

• All completed functionalities have been successfully validated by QA.

• Production monitoring items have undergone initial sanity validation.

• No critical or blocking issues were identified during validation.

### **Notes**

• Tender Monitoring exports now include additional outcome-related information wherever available.

• Archived forwarded tenders will automatically be monitored for future corrigendum updates.

• Tenders with undefined values (0, N/A, or Blank) will now be discovered and displayed.

• Consolidated corrigendum emails and hierarchy-based notification emails have been released for production monitoring and will continue to be observed using live tender updates.

• Kindly review the newly implemented functionalities during your regular workflow.

releases.name: CIMTrack DAR Release
releases.notes:
Hi Team,

We are pleased to announce that the latest **CIMTrack Daily Activity Module** enhancements have been successfully deployed and are now available for use.

The following functionalities and improvements have been implemented.

---

### **Completed Features & Enhancements**

1. **DAR Compliance Workflow**

   * Implemented a complete Daily Activity Report (DAR) compliance workflow.
   * Users are required to complete DAR before Punch-Out.
   * Users who are auto punched-out cannot Punch-In the next day until the previous day's DAR is completed.
   * Automated weekly DAR compliance reports are generated for Reporting Managers.
   * Added a dedicated DAR Reports & Dashboard module for compliance monitoring, pending DAR tracking, team analysis, and reporting.
   * Sales Team users are excluded from DAR compliance validations.

2. **DAR Edit Restriction – Mobile Application**

   * Users can edit DAR only on the same day it is submitted.
   * Previous day's DAR is automatically locked from further modifications.

3. **Punch-Out Reminder Notifications**

   * Automated reminder notifications added for users with pending Punch-Out.
   * First reminder at **07:00 PM**.
   * Second reminder at **10:00 PM** if Punch-Out is still pending.

4. **DAR Edit Restriction – Dashboard**

   * Implemented backend validation to restrict editing of DAR after the submission day.
   * Previous day's DAR remains locked across the dashboard.

5. **AI Insights User Search**

   * Added employee search functionality in the AI Insights page.
   * Reporting Managers can search and view AI insights for specific employees based on their access permissions.

6. **Daily Activity Hours Validation**

   * Implemented attendance-based validation for minimum Daily Activity hours.
   * Required activity hours are now validated according to Punch-In and Punch-Out duration.

7. **Admin Daily Activity Reports**

   * Added a new **Daily Activity Reports** module in the Admin Dashboard.
   * Supports report generation using filters such as Date Range, Week, Month, Employee, Department, and Reporting Manager.
   * Added report export functionality.

8. **Mandatory Image Upload**

   * Image upload is now mandatory when **Instrument Installation** activity is selected.
   * Users cannot submit the activity without attaching the required image.

9. **Extended Daily Activity Entry Window**

   * Increased Daily Activity submission window from **7 days to 30 days**.
   * Users can now submit missed activities for the previous 30 days while maintaining existing validations.

10. **Mandatory Description for "Other" Activity**

    * Added validation to make the Description field mandatory when **Other** is selected as the activity type.

11. **Minor Fixes & Performance Improvements**

    * Addressed various UI, usability, validation, and performance improvements across the Daily Activity module.

---

### **Highlights**

• Strengthened Daily Activity compliance and attendance validation.

• Improved reporting capabilities for Reporting Managers and Administrators.

• Enhanced employee accountability through automated reminders and DAR restrictions.

• Increased flexibility by extending the Daily Activity submission period to 30 days.

• Improved data quality with mandatory validations for Instrument Installation and Other activity types.

• Enhanced Analytics Dashboard with employee-wise AI Insights search.

---

### **QA Status**

• All functional, validation, reporting, and workflow scenarios have been successfully validated.

• No critical or blocking issues were identified during testing.

---

### **Notes**

• DAR completion is mandatory before Punch-Out (except for Sales Team users).

• Users who are auto punched-out must complete the previous day's DAR before the next Punch-In.

• DAR can only be edited on the day it is submitted.

• Instrument Installation activity requires at least one image before submission.

• The Description field is mandatory when selecting the **Other** activity type.

• Daily Activity entries can now be submitted for up to the previous **30 days**.

---

The latest build is now ready for deployment and usage.

We request all Reporting Managers to communicate these updates and new compliance requirements to their respective team members to ensure smooth adoption and adherence to the updated Daily Activity process.

If you encounter any issues or observe any functionality not working as expected, kindly let us know so that we can review and address them promptly.

Thanks & Regards,

**Dwip Pandya**

Multiple active links can be created for the same tender.
Individual links can be revoked without affecting other active links.
Shared tenders can be viewed through secure read-only access.
Manual Document Upload
Added functionality to upload additional documents directly from the Tender Details → Documents tab.
Users can upload, view, and download multiple tender-specific documents.
Pagination State Retention
Users now return to the same listing page and position when navigating back from Tender Details.
Tender Details Editing
Authorized users can manually update tender details such as bidding start dates and other configurable fields.
Interactive Monitoring Dashboard
Tender Monitoring statistics cards are now dynamic.
Clicking a statistics card automatically filters the tender listing based on the selected category.
Notification Management
Added Clear Notifications functionality.
Users can clear all notifications from the notification panel.
Notifications are managed independently for each user.
Tender Notification Navigation
Tender-related notifications are now clickable.
Users are redirected directly to the respective Tender Details page.
Submission Date Change Notifications
Users now receive notifications whenever the submission date of a forwarded tender is updated.
Tender Value Filtering
Implemented filtering logic to display only tenders with values equal to or greater than ₹40 Lakhs.

Display of AOC and winner information within Tender Details.
Corrigendum Document Visibility
Corrigendum documents are now displayed within Tender Details → Documents tab.
Download functionality supported for all applicable tender types.
Consolidated Corrigendum Email Notifications
Multiple corrigendum updates are consolidated into a single email.
Improved readability and reduced email volume.
Tender Update Email Redirection
Tender update emails now redirect users to the corresponding tender within Tender360 instead of the external portal.

releases.name: Parvati Release
releases.notes:
We have released the latest firmware version, LRTU3100_v1.0.15, for QA/UAT validation. The firmware package is available on SharePoint under 3100_1.0.15.

This release introduces several enhancements and new features. The LCD interface has been updated to display PT status with clear labels, including Main PT, PT1, and PT2, enabling easier identification and monitoring of PT connections directly from the device display.

In addition, we have introduced the first version (1.0.0) of the Android and iOS mobile applications. These applications provide mobile access to core Parvati functionalities, including real-time RTU/Gateway monitoring, device parameter management, reporting, PT monitoring, and schedule configuration. Device communication workflows have also been enhanced with support for real-time synchronization, manual data fetching, PT data retrieval, and automated valve scheduling. Furthermore, reporting capabilities, data export functions, and monitoring dashboards have been optimized to improve operational visibility and accessibility for field users.

The Android and iOS applications have been submitted to the Google Play Store and Apple App Store and are currently under review. Subject to the respective platform approval timelines, the applications are expected to be available during the upcoming week. Download links will be shared once the publication process is completed.
